scientific_integrity: Finite exact arithmetic tests corroborate identities; infinite-parameter proof is algebraic and positive-map analytic. No independent audit or independent validation is asserted.
scientific_limitations: Exactly consistent diagonal real systems, iid row-norm sampling, beta in [0,1), M in [0,1], deterministic initial error and y0=0, exact arithmetic; excludes general matrices and almost-sure claims.
title: Exact mean-square stability frontier for geometrically smoothed Kaczmarz on orthogonal systems
